title: Reject impossible dates before marking reagent lots usable
prompt:
Fix only lib/ohworks-reagent-lot.ts and a new regression test. Evidence: isUtcTimestamp at lines 145-147 merely combines endsWith('Z') with Date.parse. Its checks at lines 168-184 therefore accept nonexistent calendar dates in manufacturer expiry, use time and first-opened time. I reproduced evaluateReagentLot with a known synthetic lot, manufacturerExpiresAt='2026-02-30T08:00:00.000Z' and useAt='2026-02-20T08:00:00.000Z' returning status='usable'. The QC lot view consumes this helper at lib/ohworks-demo-qc-bracket-lot-view.ts:2, so this defect can turn invalid expiry evidence into a favorable lot status.

Strengthen the local UTC timestamp validator to reject calendar rollover before any expiry calculation. Preserve valid UTC inputs, fractional seconds, recall precedence for otherwise valid inputs, and existing missing-field behavior. Use the existing manufacturer-expiry-invalid, use-at-invalid and first-opened-at-invalid typed errors for the respective fields. Do not change other evaluators or extract a shared helper.

Add tests/ohworks/reagent-calendar-validity.test.ts with invalid dates independently in all three fields, valid leap-day controls, and unchanged exact-expiry behavior. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/reagent-calendar-validity.test.ts tests/ohworks/reagent-lot.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-qc-bracket-lot-view.test.ts. The baseline evaluator tests passed and the favorable invalid-date result was reproduced during planning. Keep fixtures synthetic; no credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json or auth changes. Work within this bounded fix and work on the assigned branch you are on.
